lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, with inter-centroid spacing increasing as the pattern extends posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a discernible lattice or grid-like structure on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow-based low luminance on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of at least five high-luminance blobs clearly contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin's surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, high-chroma yellow pixel clusters (identifiable as external commensal organisms) are visible adjacent to the head and lateral flank regions.
